summary: Tested the camera/diagnosis flow and Layers 2, 4, 5 and 6 end to end, on the backend (new pytest suite, 12 tests) and the frontend (Playwright, desktop plus a mobile check). All 47 backend tests pass, including the earlier layer1 and layer3 suites. Frontend first failed to load: the Next dev .next cache was corrupted (404 on chunks, 'Cannot find module ./611.js'). I fixed it by stopping the frontend, deleting .next and restarting. After that, almost every requested flow passed. Camera: the live dialog with a fake device captures a snap and shows the preview; when the camera is blocked, the error and 'Upload a photo' (file chooser) appear; uploading still works. Toilet photo plus note: Plumbing at Tahoe Cabin, numbered fix guide, 'Call a pro' badge and safety note; confirming creates the issue and the issue page shows issue-fix-guide. Bench: pin, status, undo and greyed unranked rows all work. Import: preview rows, duplicate merge/keep, 'Pick a trade' highlight with save disabled, save toast and undo, nothing-found message, and the manual add dialog all work. Add contractor plus undo works. Outcomes: no-show reopens the issue and opens the next-backup request dialog; undo restores; showed up resolves; edit creates a revision and re-ranks. Fix-it: order, demo items, stale and watch actions with undo, gap prefill and empty state all work. Watch: run1 and run2 messages, unranking and new Fix-it alerts all work. Host isolation works (404s). One functional bug: the earbuds photo shows the wrong notice.

minor.issue: Two different numbers for the same rating drop. The bench reason says 'Rating dropped from 4.6 to 3.9 this month' for High Desert Hot Tubs, but the Fix-it alert says 'from 4.7 to 3.9'. watch_adjustments takes the first rating from the last 31 days (the 4.6 baseline seeded at day -28) instead of the one the alert used (4.7 at day -24).

The AI draft is about the wrong trade. For a Plumbing issue sent to High Desert Hot Tubs, it wrote 'help with a hot tub issue', guessing from the business name. The draft context should include trade_needed and the amenity label.
With a note, the diagnosis is phrased as 'The note describes a toilet...' rather than talking to the host directly. Prompt wording issue.
The history check (db.requests / db.job_outcomes find_one) does not filter by host_id. Not exploitable because ids are UUIDs, but it is inconsistent with the other queries.

ui_bugs.issue: A photo of a personal item (earbuds) shows 'We couldn't tell from the photo' instead of the NOT_RENTAL notice. The AI returns can_tell=false and is_rental_issue=false, but the UI only shows NOT_RENTAL when can_tell is true. Check is_rental_issue === false first, whatever can_tell is.

integration_issues.issue: A host with zero properties and zero contractors sees the sleeping puppy 'Your bench is ready. Nothing needs you today.' This is misleading. Show an onboarding prompt (add a property, import contacts, load demo) instead.
The Requests list still shows the no-show contractor with a 'Booked' badge. It should show 'No-show'.
The toast only gives a count ('2 matched to property slots'), not the slot names. The backend already returns the slot names per contractor.

issues: The one-line reason is cut off heavily (e.g. 'Showed up 4 of 4, 4....'). Pinned rows put the pin icon on its own line, so names get cut too ('Oak Town Applian...').
The guest arrival field (capture-arrival-input) uses the browser's built-in date-time picker, not the shadcn calendar component.
The 'Bench watch' tab is cut off at the right edge with nothing showing it can scroll.
Open issues with no request yet are labelled 'Waiting on a contractor' while the title says 'needs a contractor'.

action_items: Fix the NOT_RENTAL notice in something-broke/page.jsx: show it whenever is_rental_issue === false, even if can_tell is false.
Make the bench reason use the same 'from' rating as the watch alert (scoring.watch_adjustments).
Add trade_needed and the amenity label to the draft_message context so drafts don't take the trade from the business name.
Show a no-show badge on requests whose contractor got a no-show outcome.
Replace the empty Fix-it state for hosts with no properties or contractors with onboarding.
Bench reason truncation on desktop; use the shadcn calendar for guest arrival.
Avoid running `next build` while the dev server is running: it corrupts .next and breaks the preview.
critical_code_review_comments: Pin is a single global flag per contractor, so pinning someone puts them #1 in every slot they cover (Oak Town got pinned in both Appliance and HVAC). The spec reads as a per-slot favourite; check this is what you want.
rank_changes only reports contractors ranked both before and after. Someone who drops out of the ranking gets no message.
POST /api/demo/reset also wipes the demo host's own non-demo issues. Fine for the demo account, but worth a note in the UI copy.
server.py is 730 lines, over the 700-line guideline; consider splitting out the issues and requests routes.
updated_files: /app/frontend/.next (deleted and rebuilt to fix the corrupted dev cache; frontend restarted)
seed_data_creation: None kept. Demo reset at the end; TEST_ users and their data deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest tests/ (47 tests). test_bullpup_layers2456.py resets the demo at setup and teardown and assumes the watch run counter starts at 0. Test images: /tmp/toilet.jpg (unsplash photo-1584622650111-993a426fbf0a) and /tmp/earbuds.jpg (photo-1590658268037-6bf12165a8df). The toilet photo plus note gives Plumbing at Tahoe Cabin; earbuds give can_tell=false and is_rental_issue=false. The Playwright headless browser has a fake camera (grant_permissions camera works). Simulate a blocked camera with add_init_script that rejects getUserMedia with NotAllowedError. Server clock is Oct 2026. If the frontend shows an unstyled giant puppy image, the .next cache is corrupted: stop the frontend, rm -rf .next, start it again.
rca of the issue: Frontend not loading: the .next dev cache was corrupted (missing ./611.js, Client Manifest errors), most likely from a production build overwriting .next while dev was running. Fixed by deleting .next and restarting. Earbuds notice: the AI correctly returns can_tell=false and is_rental_issue=false, but page.jsx line 48 only sets NOT_RENTAL when can_tell is true.
